product_summary: Real product range per own website (govindmilk.com/products, accessed for this review): fluid milk (cow, toned, double toned, standardized, buffalo), dahi/curd, chaas/masala chaas/mattha, lassi and mango lassi (Funzz), fresh paneer and frozen malai paneer, shrikhand/amrakhand (kesar, badam pista), butter, ice cream, basundi, ambient ghee, flavoured milk, skimmed milk powder, whole milk powder, instant dairy whitener, dessert mixes (gulab jamun, shahi dry fruit kheer, ragi kheer, rice kheer, basundi mix), sweets (kesar pedha, pedha, besan ladoo, mysore pak), UHT farm milk, fresh cream, cheese, milkshakes (vanilla, double chocolate, strawberry), rabdi, aam panna, nimbu paani. Plant at Kolki, Tal. Phaltan, Dist. Satara, Maharashtra. Site states capacity: ~30 t milk fat/day to butter & ghee, ~30,000 kg milk powder/day. B2B page states the company works as private-label / co-packing / white-label partner for milk, ghee, UHT and other products.
role_hint: manufacturer (own dairy plant at Kolki, Phaltan, Satara; private-label/co-packing also offered — no trader signs found on the website)
comment: Declared codes 0402.10 (SMP), 0402.21 (WMP) and 0405.10 (butter) are all corroborated by the website's own product list and stated daily capacities — exact match on those three lines. However the declaration covers only 3 of ~16 HS-6 lines the company actually produces: fluid milk (0401.10/0401.20), cream (0401.40/50), curd/shrikhand (0403.20), chaas/buttermilk (0403.90), ghee (0405.90), paneer/cheese (0406), dairy whitener (0404.90), ice cream/basundi/rabdi (2105.00), kheer & gulab jamun mixes (1901.90), pedha/ladoo/mysore pak (1704.90) and flavoured milk/lassi/milkshakes (2202.99) are missing from the declaration. Status = partial: correct but materially incomplete. Industry claim 'Food & FMCG' is accurate but too broad — the company is a pure dairy processor (HS ch. 04 core, with ch. 17/19/21/22 secondary). Per project rule 3 the company is retained and the code list is corrected/extended, not rejected. All product lines above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — sourced from the company's own website catalogue and B2B page only; no customs line was available to this reviewer to corroborate any specific HS code, and no shipment records were checked in this role. PAN AAACG7588A and legal-name variants were not verified here (out of scope for HS review).
